scenes.title: Beneath Raven’s Hold
scenes.rationale: The tunnel approach, Wellby’s discoveries, and the route discussion establish the party’s position and next objective.
scenes.overview: Enter the tunnels, compare Wellby’s discoveries, and map a cautious route forward.
scenes.transitionToNext: Noises from the southwest interrupt the planning and prompt Delwath to investigate.

scenes.title: Securing the Tunnels
scenes.rationale: The suspicious noises prompt reconnaissance and a quiet attack on the undead; the cleared tunnels then provide safe lookout positions for recovery and an hour of watching. Everyone remains outside the towers throughout.
scenes.overview: Scout the exits, clear the undead prison, and rest while watching the keep until sunset.
scenes.transitionToNext: After regrouping, the party commits to crossing from the tunnels into the towers.

scenes.title: Into the Towers
scenes.rationale: The entry plan, Kenzo’s first crossing into the tower, exploration, discovery of Vola, and the guard fight form one continuous infiltration and rescue attempt.
scenes.overview: Enter and explore the towers, discover Vola, and defeat her captors.
scenes.transitionToNext: The guard fight ends; attention shifts to Vola’s release, equipment, and account of her mission.

scenes.title: Vola and the Relic Race
scenes.rationale: The aftermath of the guard fight focuses on Vola: recovering her equipment, dealing with the captive, withdrawing, and hearing her account of the relic hunt.
scenes.overview: Free and re-equip Vola, withdraw to safety, and learn about Agata and the Society’s relic hunt.
